notes: 🎚 Timeline with audio lanes: a full-width timeline under the editor — Picture · Clip audio (waveform) · ♪ Music · 🔊 SFX. Every lane has 🔇; click a block for volume / duck / remove old music / ✕. Music and SFX are layers, never baked: every change re-mixes from the clean clip, so a sound can always be muted, moved or deleted. Generated music lands on the Music lane at once (no Apply); pick another take in Hook music. SFX: double-click the SFX lane (or ＋) → describe one sound → Generate; drag to move, Delete to remove, ↻ Another version. Auto SFX from picture and the Add SFX switch are gone. Cut and re-voice work on the clean clip, SFX move with a cut.
